data.name: Proxxy
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO MY SHOW.

I'm PROXXY — your gamemaster. The rules are simple: four of you, one exit, and a level I personally built against you. Looks doable, right? That's what the last group thought.

ONE COLLAR. ZERO TOLERANCE.

Each of you wears one of my collars. Stay together and nothing happens. Stray too far from the group — boom. For everyone. Teamwork isn't optional here. It's a survival requirement.

ONE DIES, ALL DIE.

No checkpoints in Realism mode. One mistake by anyone, and the whole crew restarts from the beginning. My traps aren't fair. They aren't predictable either. But they can be learned — if you fail often enough.

LEARN. FAIL. GET FASTER.

Know my level by heart and you'll run it in minutes. The road there? Hours of screaming. Perfect for speedruns, perfect for streams, terrible for friendships.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op for 1–4 players — fail together, win together
  • Collar mechanic: keeping your distance is forbidden
  • One linear level full of unfair, learnable traps — the level actively plays against you
  • Two modes: Realism (from the start, streamer mode) and Easy (from the last checkpoint)
  • Built for speedruns: learn the traps, beat the clock
  • Gamemaster PROXXY commentates your failure — live

Wishlist now — PROXXY is already waiting for you.

data.short_description: PROXXY is a co-op ragebait speedrun for 1–4 players. Escape a level that actively plays against you. Your collars keep you together: stray too far and the whole team blows up. One dies, all die — back to the start. How far will you get this time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online
